limitations: Own physical-field/KS variant is not the original three-field formulation. Gray fields, boundary stencils and mesh resolution prevent a universal minimum-feature certificate. In this bounded 24 x 8 example both length constraints remain violated and the field stays grey: on a grey field every cell violates the indicator (about 3800 times its tolerance at the uniform start), so MMA barely moves. With a Heaviside projection sharpened to beta 32 and the tolerance tightened from 100 to 1 on a 180 x 60 mm MBB (60 x 20 cells, mmapy MMA), the field becomes black and white, but 1-cell members and holes remain and the indicators stay about 5 times their tolerance; pyMOTO MMA's subproblem then takes about 30 s per step. The function does not yet show its intended behaviour; its edge stencils and KS calibration need checking against Zhou et al.
